issues.display_title: Issue #1877: feat(crm): GET /v1/crm/clients — list clients with search, pagination & tours count (+ domain scaffold)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint GET /v1/crm/clients for the CRM page (FE branch design/add-CRM-section-menu, pages/Crm/Crm.jsx — currently running on mock src/mocks/crm.js). Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.1.

This task also includes the CRM domain scaffold (created once here, reused by all other CRM endpoint tasks):

  • routes/crmRoutes.php + registration in bootstrap/app.php
  • app/Exceptions/Crm/ base (CrmDomainException, InvalidCrmRequestException, CrmClientNotFoundException, CrmTourNotFoundException, CrmForbiddenException, CrmExceptionHttpMapper)
  • tableCrmClients() helper in app/Class/DatabaseClass.php (dbModeration()->table('crm_clients'))

Request

GET /v1/crm/clients?search=&page=1&limit=10
Param Default Notes
search '' matches first_name / last_name / company / email (LIKE %..%) — parallel to FE filter (name, company, email)
page 1 min 1
limit 10 FE PAGE_SIZE = 10; clamp 1–100

Response (encrypted envelope)

{
  "pagination": { "total_data": 12, "limit": 10, "page": 1, "total_page": 2 },
  "list_clients": [
    { "id": 1001, "first_name": "Olivia", "last_name": "Bennett",
      "company": "Bennett Realty Group", "email": "olivia@bennettrealty.com",
      "phone": "+1 415 555 0142", "tours_count": 3 }
  ],
  "messages": "Data retrieved"
}

tours_count per client:

SELECT c.id, ..., COALESCE(t.tours_count, 0) AS tours_count
FROM crm_clients c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT crm_client_id, COUNT(*) AS tours_count
    FROM 0_moderation
    WHERE user_id = :user_id AND crm_client_id IS NOT NULL AND delete_space = '0'
    GROUP BY crm_client_id
) t ON t.crm_client_id = c.id
WHERE c.user_id = :user_id ...
ORDER BY c.id DESC
LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset;

Requirements

  • Owner-scoped: every query WHERE user_id = $request->user_id (from auth middleware).
  • SQL isolated in CrmRepository only; flow Controller → Validator → Action → DTO → Repository per ARCH_RULES.md.
  • client object shape identical to FE mock (first_name, last_name, company, email, phone) so the FE swap only touches src/mocks/crm.js.
  • Encrypted envelope via ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult() (default encrypted, plain via enc flag).

Errors

domainCode HTTP Condition
CRM.INVALID_INPUT 400 invalid page/limit
(fallback) 500/503 errorResponseFromThrowable()

Acceptance criteria

  • Endpoint registered under v1/crm group with auth middleware
  • Search/pagination/tours_count working, owner-scoped
  • Matches ADR layer map (Controller/Action/DTO/Validator/Repository/Exceptions)

Result

  • Implementation: Domain scaffold and `GET /v1/crm/clients` implemented adhering to ADR-Domain Architecture (`docs/ARCH_RULES.md`).
    • Route: `routes/crmRoutes.php` registered in `bootstrap/app.php` under prefix `v1/crm` with `auth` middleware.
    • Exceptions: `app/Exceptions/Crm/*` (`CrmDomainException`, `InvalidCrmRequestException`, `CrmClientNotFoundException`, `CrmTourNotFoundException`, `CrmForbiddenException`, `CrmExceptionHttpMapper`).
    • Helper: `DatabaseClass::tableCrmClients()` added for `moderation.crm_clients`.
    • ADR Components: `ListClientsController.php`, `ListClientsAction.php`, `ListClientsDto.php`, `ListClientsValidator.php`, `CrmRepository.php`.
  • Testing:
    • Unit & Integration: 54 tests passing (109 assertions) via `./vendor/bin/phpunit --filter Crm`.
    • Live E2E: Verified with account `muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com` (user_id: 50214) against dev DB. Verified search across name/company/email, pagination, and `tours_count` computation from `0_moderation`.
  • Pull Request: #1928

Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint PUT /v1/crm/clients/{id} — update an existing CRM client (edit modal on the CRM page). Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.3.

issues.display_title: Issue #1880: feat(crm): DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id} — delete client & unlink tours
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id} — hard-delete a CRM client and unlink it from every tour that references it (mirrors mock deleteClient() behavior; FE shows "unlinked from N tours" text in the confirm modal). Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.4.

Behavior — single transaction

No FK constraint exists on 0_moderation.crm_client_id (deliberate), so unlink is app-level:

START TRANSACTION;
UPDATE 0_moderation SET crm_client_id = NULL
WHERE crm_client_id = :client_id AND user_id = :user_id;
DELETE FROM crm_clients WHERE id = :client_id AND user_id = :user_id;
COMMIT;

Response (200)

{ "unlinked_tours": 3, "messages": "Success delete" }

unlinked_tours = affected rows of the UPDATE (consumed by FE t_delete.t_unlink copy).

Errors

domainCode HTTP Condition
CRM.CLIENT_NOT_FOUND 404 DELETE affected 0 rows (not found / not owned)

Requirements

  • Ownership scoped by user_id (auth middleware).
  • Transaction atomicity: unlink and delete must commit or roll back together.
  • SQL isolated in CrmRepository.

Acceptance criteria

  • Client deleted, all 0_moderation.crm_client_id references set to NULL
  • unlinked_tours reported correctly
  • 404 on missing/not-owned client

Dependencies

  • Schema: #1876 (crm_clients + crm_client_id)
  • Scaffold (route file, exceptions, DatabaseClass helper): #1877

Result

  • Implementation: `DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id}` implemented adhering to ADR-Domain Architecture.
    • ADR Components: `DeleteClientController.php`, `DeleteClientAction.php`, `CrmRepository::deleteClientAndUnlinkTours()`.
    • Transaction Atomicity: Wrapped inside `$this->db->dbModeration()->transaction()`. All `0_moderation.crm_client_id` references reset to NULL and client deleted together.
  • Testing:
    • Unit & Integration: `DeleteClientActionTest`, `CrmRepositoryTest`, `CrmControllersTest` passing.
    • Live E2E: Verified with account `muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com` (user_id: 50214). Deleting client unlinks associated tours and reports `unlinked_tours: N` with HTTP 200. Missing client returns 404.
  • Pull Request: #1928

issues.display_title: Issue #1881: feat(crm): GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client — get assigned client for a tour
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client — the assigned client for a single tour. Consumed by ClientBadge in TourSummary (tour detail header) and the Tour Detail CRM section (useTourClient(mid) swap). Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.5.

Request

GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client

mid = 0_moderation.moderation_id.

Response (200)

{ "client": { "id": 1001, "first_name": "Olivia", "last_name": "Bennett",
              "company": "Bennett Realty Group", "email": "olivia@bennettrealty.com",
              "phone": "+1 415 555 0142" },
  "messages": "Data retrieved" }

client is null when the tour has no assigned client.

SQL

SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.email, c.phone
FROM 0_moderation m
JOIN crm_clients c ON c.id = m.crm_client_id
WHERE m.moderation_id = :mid AND m.user_id = :user_id
LIMIT 1;

Errors

domainCode HTTP Condition
CRM.TOUR_NOT_FOUND 404 mid not found / not owned by caller

Acceptance criteria

  • Returns assigned client or null
  • Ownership enforced, 404 on mismatch
  • Encrypted envelope response

Dependencies

  • Schema: #1876 (crm_clients + crm_client_id)
  • Scaffold (route file, exceptions, DatabaseClass helper): #1877

Result

  • Implementation: `GET /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client` implemented adhering to ADR-Domain Architecture.
    • ADR Components: `GetTourClientController.php`, `GetTourClientAction.php`, `CrmRepository::findClientByTourMid()`, `CrmRepository::checkTourOwnership()`.
    • Behavior: Returns assigned client object or `client: null` if unassigned. Returns 404 `CRM.TOUR_NOT_FOUND` if `mid` does not belong to user.
  • Testing:
    • Unit & Integration: `GetTourClientActionTest`, `CrmRepositoryTest`, `CrmControllersTest` passing.
    • Live E2E: Verified with account `muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com` (user_id: 50214) on tour `3556442`. Correctly returns client when assigned and null when unassigned.

issues.display_title: Issue #1882: feat(crm): GET /v1/crm/tours/clients — batch client lookup by mids
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint GET /v1/crm/tours/clients — batch lookup of the assigned client for many tours in one request. Consumed by ClientBadge on TourCard so the tours list needs one request per page instead of N. Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.6.

⚠️ Route registration order: register this route before GET /tours/{mid}/client so the literal clients segment is not captured by the {mid} parameter.

Request

GET /v1/crm/tours/clients?mids=12345,12346,12399
  • mids = comma-separated 0_moderation.moderation_ids, max 100 → CRM.INVALID_INPUT (400) otherwise.

Response (200)

{
  "clients": {
    "12345": { "id": 1001, "first_name": "Olivia", "...": "..." },
    "12346": null
  },
  "messages": "Data retrieved"
}

SQL

SELECT m.moderation_id, c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.email, c.phone
FROM 0_moderation m
LEFT JOIN crm_clients c ON c.id = m.crm_client_id
WHERE m.moderation_id IN (:mids) AND m.user_id = :user_id;

Requirements

  • Idempotent per item: missing/not-owned mids map to null (no per-item error).
  • Owner-scoped by user_id (auth middleware).
  • SQL isolated in CrmRepository.

Acceptance criteria

  • Batch of ≤100 mids resolved in one query
  • Unknown/not-owned mids → null (no 404 per item)
  • Route order verified (not shadowed by {mid} route)

Dependencies

  • Schema: #1876 (crm_clients + crm_client_id)
  • Scaffold (route file, exceptions, DatabaseClass helper): #1877

Result

  • Implementation: `GET /v1/crm/tours/clients` implemented adhering to ADR-Domain Architecture.
    • ADR Components: `BatchTourClientsController.php`, `BatchTourClientsAction.php`, `BatchTourClientsDto.php`, `BatchTourClientsValidator.php`, `CrmRepository::findClientsByTourMids()`.
    • Route Ordering: Declared before `/tours/{mid}/client` in `routes/crmRoutes.php` to prevent route shadowing by `{mid}`.
    • Batching: Resolves up to 100 mids in a single query with LEFT JOIN. Unowned/unassigned mids map to null.
  • Testing:
    • Unit & Integration: `BatchTourClientsActionTest`, `BatchTourClientsValidatorTest`, `CrmControllersTest` passing.
    • Live E2E: Verified with account `muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com` (user_id: 50214). Successfully returned dictionary mapping for multiple tours.
  • Pull Request: #1928

issues.display_title: Issue #1883: feat(crm): PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client — assign or unassign client to tour
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

New ADR-Domain endpoint PUT /v1/crm/tours/{mid}/client — assign or unassign a CRM client to a tour. Single behavior feeding both the CRM dropdown on Tour Detail and the "remove selected" button (mock: assignTourClient(mid, clientId|null)). Design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md §4.7.

WHERE moderation_id = :mid AND user_id = :user_id;

Response (200)

{ "client": { "id": 1001, "...": "..." }, "messages": "Success update" }

(client = null on unassign)

Requirements

  • Owner-scoped by user_id (auth middleware).
  • SQL isolated in CrmRepository.

Acceptance criteria

  • Assign & unassign both work (null clears the relation)
  • Validation order enforced (tour first, then client)
  • Encrypted envelope response

Dependencies

  • Schema: #1876 (crm_clients + crm_client_id)

Result

issues.display_title: Issue #1876: feat(schema): add crm_clients table and crm_client_id column on 0_moderation
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

DB schema change required by the CRM dashboard feature (FE branch design/add-CRM-section-menu, design doc: docs/crm/CRM_API_DESIGN.md). No CRM/clients tables exist in any database (audited 2026-09-15 across gothru_mod, moderation, ccdb, hosted_tours, gothru_download_q, 360directory, best360viewer — only match was gothru_mod.oauth_clients, which is unrelated). Executed manually by the operator — no migration code in this repo (database/migrations is intentionally kept empty per project convention).

SQL

CREATE TABLE `moderation`.`crm_clients` (
    `id`          BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `user_id`     INT UNSIGNED    NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owner — gothru_mod.users.user_id',
    `first_name`  VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Required (FE)',
    `last_name`   VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    `company`     VARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    `email`       VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Required (FE), indexed, NOT unique',
    `phone`       VARCHAR(50)     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    `created_at`  TIMESTAMP       NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    `updated_at`  TIMESTAMP       NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    KEY `idx_crm_clients_user_id` (`user_id`),
    KEY `idx_crm_clients_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
  COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  COMMENT='CRM client directory, per-user/agency (owner scoping via user_id)';

ALTER TABLE `moderation`.`0_moderation`
    ADD COLUMN `crm_client_id` INT UNSIGNED NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER `business_name`,
    ADD INDEX `idx_0_moderation_crm_client_id` (`crm_client_id`);

Notes

  • Core relation: 1 tour (0_moderation) ↔ 1 client; 1 client can have many tours (feeds the "Tours Count" column on the CRM page).
  • Table lives in the moderation DB — same MySQL server as 0_moderation so joins are local; connection moderation is already registered for both DEV and LIVE in config/database.php.
  • No FK constraint on the legacy 0_moderation table (huge legacy table, risky ALTER) — unlink is done app-level inside a transaction by the DELETE endpoint (task for DELETE /v1/crm/clients/{id}).
  • email indexed but not unique — FE does not enforce uniqueness.
  • utf8mb4 — client names/company can contain non-latin characters (FE seed data: Tomás Novák, etc.).
  • crm_client_id is nullable → safe for existing rows (all NULL), NULL = tour without client.

Acceptance criteria

  • crm_clients table exists on moderation DB (DEV & LIVE) with utf8mb4 charset
  • 0_moderation has nullable crm_client_id column + index
  • Existing rows unaffected (all crm_client_id NULL)

Result (Verification Evidence)

Verified on database moderation (2026-09-23):

  1. crm_clients Table:

    • Status: EXISTS
    • Engine: InnoDB, Charset: utf8mb4, Collation: utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    • Primary Key: id (bigint unsigned, AUTO_INCREMENT)
    • Indexes: idx_crm_clients_user_id (user_id), idx_crm_clients_email (email)
    • Current Row Count: 0

  2. 0_moderation.crm_client_id Column & Index:

    • Column Status: EXISTS (int unsigned, NULL allowed, default NULL)
    • Position: Directly after business_name (ordinal position 8)
    • Index Status: EXISTS (idx_0_moderation_crm_client_id on column crm_client_id, BTREE)
    • Current Data: Existing rows unaffected (728,245 rows NULL, 5 rows 0)

issues.display_title: Issue #1931: feat(auth): User Session & Identity Updates - Safe Linking, Encrypted Token Storage, and Backchannel Logout
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/gothru-sso#13 (Task 4: User Session & Identity Updates)

Summary

Ensure GoThru API reliably maps local users and sessions to the central Keycloak identity, enforcing safe linking policy, server-side encrypted token storage in Redis, and OIDC backchannel global logout.

Scope & Subtasks

  • Subtask 4.2: Safe Linking Policy & Email Verification
    • Verify email_verified claim from Keycloak JWT claims.
    • Reject auto-linking and JIT registration if Keycloak email is unverified with AUTH.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED (HTTP 422).
    • Enforce account linking safety: if local user is already linked to a different keycloak_sub, return controlled conflict state AUTH.LINKING_CONFLICT (HTTP 409).
  • Subtask 4.3: Store Tokens for Global Logout (Server-Side Redis)
    • Implement AES-256-GCM encryption with 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag, and key ID rotation support via KeycloakSessionStorage.
    • Store Keycloak refresh token and session metadata at Redis key keycloak_session:{local_session_id}.
    • Align TTL with refresh token lifetime: ttl = min(refresh_expires_in, session_ttl).
    • Ensure raw refresh token is kept server-side only and never exposed to client or logged.
  • Subtask 4.4: Implement Backchannel Global Logout
    • In LogoutAction (POST /v1/auth/logout), load and decrypt the stored Keycloak refresh token from Redis.
    • Terminate Keycloak session backchannel via OIDC logout endpoint (POST /realms/{realm}/protocol/openid-connect/logout).
    • Delete keycloak_session:{local_session_id} from Redis and clear local database session.
    • Handle expired or invalid tokens gracefully; never break local logout if Keycloak fails.
    • Zero token or secret logging on failures.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Verified Keycloak email is enforced before linking or auto-provisioning.
  • Conflict protection prevents hijacking an account already linked to another Keycloak UUID.
  • Refresh token is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) in Redis under keycloak_session:{sid}.
  • Backchannel logout revokes the Keycloak session upon POST /v1/auth/logout.
  • Zero tokens or secrets are logged.
  • Unit tests pass for storage encryption, login linking, and backchannel logout.

Result

Implemented and merged via #1930.

  • KeycloakTokenHelper: Added email_verified and exp claim extraction to verifyAndGetClaims(). Added logoutWithRefreshToken() method to perform backchannel HTTP POST logout to Keycloak's OIDC end-session endpoint with safe logging (zero tokens logged).
  • KeycloakLoginAction & AuthExceptionHttpMapper: Enforced email verification requirement for auto-linking and JIT registration (AUTH.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED / 422). Enforced conflict check preventing account takeover if already linked to a different keycloak_sub (AUTH.LINKING_CONFLICT / 409).
  • KeycloakSessionStorage (new): RFC 5116 / AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption helper storing session payloads under keycloak_session:{sid} in Redis Toronto with TTL aligned to min(refresh_expires_in, session_ttl). Supports key rotation via key_id.
  • KeycloakLoginController: Storing encrypted Keycloak session in Redis upon successful login when refresh_token is provided.
  • LogoutAction: On logout, loads and decrypts stored refresh token, invokes Keycloak backchannel logout, purges Redis session key, deletes local DB session, and revokes GT token denylist with graceful error fallback.
  • AuthSessionRepository: Added keycloak_sub column selection to findUserByEmail and findUserByKeycloakSub to support safe linking checks.
  • Documentation: Updated docs/v2/auth/keycloak-login.md and docs/v2/auth/logout.md.
  • Unit Tests:
    • KeycloakSessionStorageTest: Encryption/decryption roundtrip, Redis storage/load with TTL, expired token rejection, session deletion.
    • KeycloakLoginActionTest: Added tests for unverified email rejection, linking conflict detection, and successful safe linking.
    • LogoutActionTest: Added tests for Keycloak backchannel logout invocation, Redis session deletion, and graceful error handling on Keycloak timeout.
    • KeycloakTokenHelperTest: Added tests for client validation and empty/unconfigured logout handling.
    • All tests passing 100% (21 assertions).
